notes.title: Update notes for 1.7.8
notes.notes:
A patch that fixes a few reported bugs:
- Fixed an achievement not being given when beating the normal ending
- Fixed a story incoherence in the Temple with the Handmaid talking despite not being able to at the time
- Fixed more typos

notes.title: Update notes for 1.7.7
notes.notes:
A patch that fixes a LOT of reported and found bugs:
- Fixed a sound effect in the library
- John's Hammertime is now a physical attack like it should be
- Fixed wrong OST when losing against fin
- Fixed several speed resets if using a certain cheat code
- Nerfed Crowbar so he applies his mute debuff a bit less often
- Fixed one of the orb visions in stitch's trial
- Fixed the clock fight not applying post-combat actions (sassacre, resetting john's speed...)
- Licorice candies now cleanse all debuffs
- Fixed some tiles of Doc Scratch's quiz still being active after finishing it
- Fixed one wrong line about time instead of clocks in Dave's quest
- Hopefully fixed a bug where going to the quiz room from the south after finishing it would cause a black scree
- Rewrote some hints/explanations
- Fixed some typos

notes.title: Update notes for 1.7.6
notes.notes:
A patch that should fix the remaining reported bugs so far:
- Re-fixes wind room
- Allows the medallion achievement to be earned outside Nightmare Mode
- Fix fullscreen behavior in some machines (remember F5 is the key you should be using!)
- Fixed a typo

notes.title: Read this for important info about Felt Mansion!
notes.notes: [p]Hi, we hope you've been enjoying release day! [/p][p]This is an indie game using an ancient engine, so there are some known and expected issues, as well as some others we're working on fixing. This announcement is a heads up on that with some other information that might be useful to you as a new player.[/p][h2]Important tips[/h2][list][*][p][b]Never press the F12 key[/b]. It will reset the game, losing any unsaved progress. Due to an engine limitation we can't remove this keybind or change it to something else. I myself lost progress during playtesting so trust me that I understand how frustrating this is. The game doesn't have Steam Overlay/Steam Screenshot support to begin with, so you'll have to take screenshots with an external program.[/p][/*][*][p]If the action combat system is destroying you, especially around the Die boss fight, you can change the game's difficulty in a room west of the entry hall's first save point.[/p][/*][*][p]A few known bugs as of 6/13:[/p][list][*][p]Wind Room softlock: we fixed this before release, but it cropped up again. It was just fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Two music-related crashes before and during the final boss: both should have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Asset-related crash when looking at an item near the Library: fixed last patch.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]We're actively addressing bugs, so please let us know in the game's Community Hub if you find some, and thanks in advance![/p]
